Let me try: click the green frame border (1,27), then SPACE, and observe. But be careful about the explore batch stopping on no_impact. To avoid interruption, let me execute one action at a time with intent='solve'… no, actually, the default explore stopping on no_impact is fine for probing — it just tells me.
